evidence.notes: An explicit Object record with allOrNone=false returns a successful SaveResult and persists the updated Account.

source.content: Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'Boolean Insert'); insert inserted; Object updatedObject = new Account(Id = inserted.Id, Name = 'Boolean Updated'); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(updatedObject, false); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Id = :inserted.Id AND Name = 'Boolean Updated']);
